stored.description: False: nothing saved yet, the server default applies.
stored.title: Stored

206.description: Requested byte range of the WAV

post.description:
Applies to calls created afterwards; live calls keep their mode. Audited as
`user_admin` (target `setting:voice_mode`, from/to only): audit row flushed, object put,
commit; a failed put rolls back, a failed commit puts the previous object back.

503.description: A cap is reached or the voice service is unavailable.

200.description: text/event-stream of `event: call` messages carrying a CallEvent; the current state first, then changes, comment heartbeats, closed after `ended`.

409.description: The call cannot reconnect now (ended, crisis, handoff pending, a reconnect already in progress, or the reconnect limit was reached).

503.description: The new session could not be started.

post.summary: Replace a failed media connection with a new session

409.description: No pending session swap with that session_seq (none, already answered, timed out, or the call has ended).

503.description: The new session could not be started.

post.summary: Answer a session swap with a new SDP offer

503.description: At least one dependency is unreachable (degraded).
